pendingOutings.line: 新包质量还可以，装满准备晚上的排练了。👍
教案写一半下楼买个咖啡，下午课还挺多的。

items.imgPrompt: A black metal manual coffee grinder, placed on a wooden kitchen counter, natural morning light, minor scratches on the handle, cozy kitchen background

desc.zh: 沒別的好，就是省力。現在換電動的了，這個擱著落灰。買去自己磨，別總喝速溶，對嗓子和身體都不好。
desc.zh_cn: 没别的好，就是省力。现在换电动的了，这个搁着落灰。买去自己磨，别总喝速溶，对嗓子和身体都不好。
desc.en: Nothing special, just saves effort. Switched to an electric one, this is collecting dust. Buy it and grind your own; stop drinking instant coffee, it's bad for your throat and health.

items.imgPrompt: A blue metal guitar delay pedal, placed on a grey studio carpet, visible paint chips on corners, realistic wear and tear

desc.zh: 陪我跑過不少演出的老夥計。音色沒問題，外殼有些磕碰掉漆，玩搖滾的懂的自然懂。不議價，希望去個懂它的人手裏。
desc.zh_cn: 陪我跑过不少演出的老伙计。音色没问题，外壳有些磕碰掉漆，玩摇滚的懂的自然懂。不议价，希望去个懂它的人手里。
desc.en: An old partner that accompanied me through many gigs. The tone is perfect, though the casing has some chips and wear. Rockers will understand. No bargaining, hope it goes to someone who appreciates it.

items.imgPrompt: Black professional over-ear headphones, resting on a wooden desk next to a synthesizer, soft studio lighting, clean condition

desc.zh: 在國外讀書時買的備用耳機，沒戴過幾次。聲音底子特乾淨，還原度高。拿去聽歌或者做音樂都行。對了，別戴著它睡覺，壓耳朵。
desc.zh_cn: 在国外读书时买的备用耳机，没戴过几次。声音底子特干净，还原度高。拿去听歌或者做音乐都行。对了，别戴着它睡觉，压耳朵。
desc.en: A backup pair of headphones I bought while studying abroad, barely worn. Extremely clean sound with high fidelity. Good for casual listening or music production. By the way, don't wear them to sleep, they hurt your ears.

items.imgPrompt: A neatly folded chunky black wool scarf, lying on a beige fabric sofa, warm indoor lighting, soft texture

desc.zh: 長春的冬天有多冷不用我多說，不戴圍巾脖子往裏灌風。這條買來沒戴過，乾淨的。要是某個笨蛋出門嫌冷，直接拿去。
desc.zh_cn: 长春的冬天有多冷不用我多说，不戴围巾脖子往里灌风。这条买来没戴过，干净的。要是某个笨蛋出门嫌冷，直接拿去。
desc.en: No need for me to tell you how cold winters in Changchun get; the wind just blows right down your neck without a scarf. This one is brand new and clean. If a certain idiot gets cold going out, just take it.

items.imgPrompt: A dark brown distressed leather notebook with a strap closure, resting on a rustic wooden coffee table, soft natural light

desc.zh: 本來想買來寫歌詞，但我習慣了隨手扯張草稿紙寫，根本用不上。皮質挺厚實，放包裏挺合適的。適合拿去記筆記……或者寫日記。
desc.zh_cn: 本来想买来写歌词，但我习惯了随手扯张草稿纸写，根本用不上。皮质挺厚实，放包里挺合适的。适合拿去记笔记……或者写日记。
desc.en: Originally bought this to write lyrics, but I'm used to just grabbing scrap paper, so I never used it. The leather is thick and fits nicely in a bag. Good for taking notes... or writing a diary.
